channel.title: islammdshariful
channel.description: A hungry bug's blog about QA, automation and AI.

item.title: The AI QA Setup I Use Every Day: A PR Test Planner, a QA Executor and a Shared Memory
item.description: Two Claude Code skills that I built and use on every pull request: a PR Test Planner that plans the tests and a QA Executor that runs them, with one shared memory that the whole team reads and writes.

item.title: How I Built My Blog with Astro: A Bug Cursor, a Feeding Ground and GitHub Pages
item.description: How I built a playful personal blog with Astro: a bug cursor, posts as food on a feeding ground, a floating dock, Pagefind search, dark mode and automatic GitHub Pages deploys.

item.title: How I Run WordPress Plugin E2E Tests in Parallel: A Docker Site Pool and a Pinned Playwright Box
item.description: How I test a WordPress plugin in parallel: every Playwright worker gets its own WordPress site from a generated Docker pool, and every screenshot is taken inside one pinned Playwright container, so a laptop and CI agree to the pixel.
